<its answer>: No: employment tracks the neighbouring counties in every year after the raise, while wages pull ahead.

<its answer>: About one job in four paid less than the new minimum in 2018; by 2020 hardly any did.

<the question the plot asks>: Did places where the minimum bit harder lose more jobs?
